name: thruk-mcp
title: Thruk MCP Server
description: MCP server exposing the Thruk REST API (Naemon/Nagios/Icinga monitoring) to MCP-compatible LLM clients.

tools.name: thruk_top_noisy_hosts
tools.description: Return the top N hosts ranked by HOST ALERT count over a time window.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc:
Structured filter tree supporting AND/OR nesting.

Two node types:
  leaf:  {"type":"leaf",  "field":"...", "op":"...", "value":...}
  group: {"type":"group", "operator":"and"|"or", "conditions":[...]}

Available fields: custom_var, host, hostgroup
Operators: eq, gte, in, lte, neq, regex

Examples:

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 24 h.

arguments.name: backends
arguments.desc: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

tools.name: thruk_host_availability
tools.description: Compute availability (uptime / SLA %) for a host over a configurable time window.

arguments.name: host
arguments.desc: Host name

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-7d", "-1m") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-01 00:00:00"). Default: last 7 days. Ignored when ``timeperiod`` is set.

arguments.name: until
arguments.desc: End of analysis window (same formats as ``since``). Defaults to now. Ignored when ``timeperiod`` is set.

arguments.name: timeperiod
arguments.desc: Thruk-native time period shortcut: "last24hours", "lastweek", "lastmonth", "thismonth", etc. Overrides ``since``/``until`` when provided.

arguments.name: with_downtimes
arguments.desc: Count scheduled downtime periods as outages (withdowntimes=1).

arguments.name: include_soft_states
arguments.desc: Include soft state changes in calculations (includesoftstates=1).

arguments.name: backends
arguments.desc: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.
